{{Quote|No one has ever shown me that they care. Not my entire life."<br />"No one? Not ever?"<br />"No one. Ever. Not even my brother, so-called Mr. Love. What a phony he is, if you ask me. But you...thank you..|Mister Hate, after a spacer shows him love|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Mister Hate''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was the brother to a man known as [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Schill]], or Mr. Love. During the [[Festival of Love]] sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Dr. Schill asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to show love to his brother. The spacer located Mister Hate near a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Mister Hate lashed out violently, but when the spacer showed him love, he was overwhelmed. No one, not even Mr. Love, had showed him such compassion.<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mister Hate was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
